headline: Premier League recap: Arsenal get big win at Sunderland, Spurs still winless
description: What a Saturday! Defending champs Arsenal dug deep to win 2-0 at Sunderland, Tottenham's search for a win -- and a goal -- continues as they drew 0-0 vs. Everton, and Chelsea had to settle for a 2-2 draw vs. Hull.

headline: Winless Tottenham lack confidence and physical conditioning - Roberto De Zerbi
description: Roberto de Zerbi has admitted Tottenham lack "physical condition" and "confidence" but insisted they can overcome their slow start to the season.

headline: Nicol: Everton are a mid-table side at best
description: Nicol: Everton are a mid-table side at best

headline: Nicol: De Zerbi should be concerned about Tottenham's attack
description: Nicol: De Zerbi should be concerned about Tottenham's attack

headline: Winless Tottenham still searching for first goal of season after draw with Everton
description: Tottenham Hotspur fired another blank after being frustrated by Everton in a 0-0 draw to extend their winless start to the new Premier League season to four matches.

headline: Andoni Iraola cites 'lack of freshness' after Liverpool's draw with Fulham
description: Liverpool manager Andoni Iraola said his players were tired but refused to use it as an excuse after being held to a 0-0 draw by Fulham at Anfield.
